scenes.narration: Corridor is a portable, zero-knowledge proof of eligibility for cross-border payments.
Do your KYC once, with a regulated issuer. Then prove you're cleared to any payment corridor, without re-uploading documents, and without revealing who you are.

An issuer signs a short-lived statement. The holder proves knowledge of it in zero knowledge, right on their own device. Stellar then verifies the actual proof on-chain, binds it to the corridor's policy, and burns the nullifier. And the payout gates on-chain, with zero identity data.

This isn't a mock-up. Every registered corridor runs the real UltraHonk verifier — an OpenZeppelin-audited core, checking real proofs from Barretenberg on Stellar testnet. These contract addresses and the pass count are read straight from the chain.

Operators can check a clearance directly, no wallet required. The pre-filled pass here was granted by a real zero-knowledge proof — verified on-chain before its nullifier was burned. This calls is-cleared on-chain, read only, right from the browser.
Every observer sees only what they need. A Stellar watcher sees a pass was granted, never who. A Midnight observer sees only the issuer registry. Nobody sees your identity.
Corridor. Built with love, for Stellar. Explore the code, and contribute through the Stellar Drips Wave.
